declarations.description:
Colour-theme switcher. The trigger shows the icon of the mode currently in effect and clicking it steps to the next
one, wrapping around — a two-state control is therefore a plain light/dark toggle. With three or more modes the
trigger also opens a menu on hover (or focus, or ArrowDown) so any mode can be picked directly, while the click-to-
advance behaviour keeps working.

By default the component owns the page theme: it writes the resolved scheme to `data-theme` on `<html>`, remembers
the choice in `localStorage` under `storage-key`, restores it on load, follows the OS preference live while the
`system` mode is selected, and stays in sync with other tabs and with other instances on the page. Set `manual` to
take that over yourself and only listen for `theme-change`.

slots.description: Replaces the built-in moon icon of the `dark` mode.
slots.name: dark-icon

slots.description: Mark shown beside the selected row in the menu. Defaults to a check.

members.name: modes
members.description: The states to cycle through: `"system,light,dark"`, a JSON array, or objects from script.

members.name: value
members.description: The mode in effect. Assigning it selects that mode silently; `select()` and `next()` report the change.

members.name: menu
members.description: When to offer the dropdown: `auto` (three or more modes), `always`, or `never`.

members.name: placement
members.description: Preferred placement of the menu (floating-ui names).

members.name: showLabel
members.description: Show the current mode's label beside its icon.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

members.name: manual
members.description: Do not touch the document or storage; the host applies the theme itself from `theme-change`.

members.name: target
members.description: Element the scheme is written to, or the id of one. Defaults to `<html>`.

members.name: themeAttribute
members.description: Attribute written on the target, `data-theme` by default.

members.name: storageKey
members.description: `localStorage` key the chosen mode is remembered under. Empty disables persistence.

members.name: openDelay
members.description: Milliseconds the pointer must rest on the trigger before the menu opens.

members.name: closeDelay
members.description: Milliseconds the menu stays open after the pointer leaves, so it can be crossed into.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the trigger. Defaults to `Theme: <current label>`.

members.name: open
members.description: Whether the dropdown is showing.

members.name: systemDark
members.description: Live `prefers-color-scheme: dark`, used to resolve the `system` mode.

members.name: icons
members.description:
Slotted per-mode icons, cloned once per place they appear. A node lives in exactly one parent and a named slot is
assigned exactly once, so the trigger and the mode's menu row each need their own copy; the assignment itself
happens in a hidden set of source slots, one per mode, so every mode's icon is collected and not just the current
one's. Cloning at `slotchange` rather than at render keeps the node identity stable between updates.

members.name: iconSources
members.description: What each icon slot was last assigned, so a repeated read does not re-clone and re-render.

members.name: applied
members.description: Nothing has been applied yet, so the first render must write the theme even if `value` did not change.

members.name: resolvedModes
members.description: The modes, normalized and with every default filled in.

members.name: currentMode
members.description: The mode currently in effect, always one of resolvedModes.

members.name: resolvedTheme
members.description: The scheme in effect: the current mode's, with `system` resolved against the OS preference.

members.name: hasMenu
members.description: Whether the dropdown is offered at all.

members.name: select
members.description: Selects a mode by value and fires `theme-change`. Unknown values are ignored.

members.name: next
members.description: Advances to the next mode, wrapping around — what a click on the trigger does.

members.name: showMenu
members.description: Opens the dropdown, when there is one.

members.name: hideMenu
members.description: Closes the dropdown.

members.name: applyTheme
members.description: Writes the resolved scheme onto the target and remembers the mode. A no-op in `manual` mode.

members.name: handleStorage
members.description: Another tab (or another instance writing the same key) changed the stored mode.

members.name: syncOutsideDismiss
members.description: `popover="manual"` never light-dismisses, so an outside press has to close the menu by hand.

members.name: handleFocusOut
members.description: Keyboard users leave the menu by tabbing out of it.

members.name: handlePointerEnter
members.description: The pointer is over the trigger or the menu: cancel a pending close, schedule the open.

members.name: handleOverlayToggle
members.description: The overlay light-dismisses itself (Escape, outside press); mirror that back into `open`.

members.name: renderIcon
members.description: The slotted icon for this place, or the built-in one. Decorative either way: the row is named by its label.

members.name: renderIconSources
members.description: Hidden: this is where the per-mode icon slots live, so every mode's icon is assigned, not just the current one's.

events.name: theme-change
events.description: The scheme in effect changed: a mode was picked, or the OS preference moved while `system` was selected. `detail.value` is the mode, `detail.theme` the scheme it resolves to. Does not bubble; assigning `value` from script is silent.
